title: Color Fun
yt_description:
Teach your toddler about colors of everyday things with this catchy song. Learn about the colors of a red apple, a yellow sun, and more. This song is designed for 2-5 year olds to learn and have fun with colors.

🎵 Color Fun

Hello friends
Let's learn
Colors fun

Red apple
Yellow sun
Blue sky

Colors everywhere
Let's find
More colors

Colors everywhere
Let's find
More colors

Bye friends
Colors fun
Learned today

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.

#Shorts #KidsSongs #colors #everydaythings #toddlers
